meta.name: analogy-chain
meta.description: Chain analogies to deeper levels (3-5 layers). Each layer reveals new aspects and insights not visible at the surface.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 层层深入类比，发现隐藏洞见
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要从不同角度理解复杂概念或激发创意。
copy.tagline_en: Chain analogies deeper to uncover hidden insights
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand complex concepts from new angles or spark creativity.

howto.what: Claude 会基于你提供的初始类比，构建 3-5 层递进的类比链，每层揭示表面下新的方面和洞见。
howto.when: 当你给出一个初始类比（如“时间像河流”），并要求深入挖掘多层类比时触发。

say.text: 从“时间像河流”开始，做 3 层深层类比。
say.note: Claude 会生成递进的类比链。

say.text: 对“记忆像图书馆”进行 4 层类比链。

howto.what_en: Claude will take an initial analogy you provide and build a chain of 3-5 progressively deeper analogies, each layer revealing new aspects and insights hidden at the surface.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an initial analogy (e.g., 'time is like a river') and request a multi-layer analogy chain.

say_en.text: Start with 'time is like a river' and create 3 deep analogy layers.
say_en.note: Claude generates a chain of analogies.

say_en.text: Chain 4 analogies from 'memory is like a library'.
